title: Git publication
subtitle: Push commits, open pull requests and merge through approved publication targets.
notice: Every request is checked against the target’s approved bindings and your authority at the moment you send it. An uncertain outcome on the host is never sent again: reconcile it to read the host.

targets.title: Publication targets
targets.description: Each target binds an approved credential and repository to a push prefix and the branches it may merge into.
targets.emptyAdmin: Select a workspace and create a target from an approved credential binding and repository binding.
targets.emptyReader: A target administrator creates targets. Targets you can read are listed here.

target.title: Target {{id}}
target.description: The binding this target publishes through, the authority each action requires and the intents it holds.
target.bindingHint: Pushes stay under the push prefix, and pull requests and merges go only into the merge bases. The engine checks that both bindings are approved in the workspace each time a request is sent.
target.deleteDescription: The engine refuses to delete a target that a dispatching, uncertain or abandoned intent still holds.

targetForm.description: Bind an approved credential and repository to the branches this target may publish.
targetForm.credentialHint: The ID of a credential binding approved in this workspace. The console never sees its secret.
targetForm.repositoryHint: The ID of a repository binding approved in this workspace. Its owner must be one the credential binding allows.
targetForm.keepBinding: Leave empty to keep the current binding.
targetForm.prefixHint: Pushes must stay under this branch prefix. It ends with a slash and may not cover a merge base.
targetForm.prefixSlash: The push prefix must end with a slash.
targetForm.basesHint: The branches pull requests and merges may target, one per line. At most 16.

authority.requiresStepUp: Requires {{permission}} and the extra check for administrative actions

push.title: Push a commit
push.description: Pushes one exact commit to a branch under {{prefix}}, leased on the branch’s expected current commit.

pull_request.title: Open a pull request
pull_request.description: Opens a pull request from a branch under {{prefix}} into a merge base, or adopts the matching open one.

merge.title: Merge a pull request
merge.description: Merges one pull request only while its head is still the reviewed commit.

session.title: Publish
session.hint: Push this session’s commit through the publication target of its workspace. The engine fetches the commit from the session’s folder.

fields.refHint: A full ref under the push prefix, for example refs/heads/{{prefix}}change.
fields.expectedOldHint: Optional. The push is leased on this value; leave it empty for a new branch.
fields.treeHint: The commit’s tree ID. The engine refuses the push if the managed repository holds a different tree.
fields.sessionRunHint: Optional. The session run whose folder holds the commit. The engine fetches the commit from it into the managed repository first.
fields.sessionRunFixedHint: The session this push comes from. The engine fetches the commit from its folder into the managed repository first.
fields.title: Title
fields.expectedHeadHint: The merge happens only while the pull request’s head is this commit.
fields.acknowledgeIntentHint: Optional. The ID of an abandoned intent that holds this scope. Naming it needs target administration.
fields.operationIdHint: Sending this same request again with this ID returns the recorded intent. It does not dispatch a second time.

receipts.caused: This request caused the effect on the host.
receipts.existing_effect: A matching effect already existed on the host and was adopted.
receipts.none: No effect on the host is attributed to this request.

uncertain.title: The outcome on the host is uncertain
uncertain.body: The request was dispatched, but its result on the host is not confirmed. It may have landed. Do not send it again: reconcile reads the host and records what it observes.

rejected.title: The host rejected the request
rejected.body: The host refused the effect. The intent records the refusal.

unknown.title: The engine’s answer did not arrive
unknown.body: The request may have been recorded. Open this target’s intents to see whether it was, and reconcile it there if it is uncertain.

refusals.authority_expired: The authority check did not finish in time, so the request was not carried out.
refusals.authority_unavailable: The engine could not decide on this request, so it was not carried out.
refusals.base_not_allowed: The base branch is not one of this target’s merge bases.
refusals.binding_not_approved: A credential binding or repository binding is not approved in this workspace.
refusals.content_mismatch: The commit or tree does not match what the managed repository holds.
refusals.default_branch_refused: The branch is the repository’s default branch, and publishing to it is refused.
refusals.dispatch_deadline_passed: The dispatch deadline passed before the request was sent. Nothing was dispatched.
refusals.field_not_accepted: The request carried a field this route does not accept.
refusals.forbidden: Your current authority does not allow this action on this target.
refusals.head_mismatch: The pull request’s head is no longer the reviewed commit.
refusals.host_credential_refused: The Git host refused the binding’s credential or its scope. Nothing was dispatched.
refusals.host_unavailable: The Git host could not be reached. Nothing was dispatched.
refusals.intent_settled: The intent is already settled, so it cannot be abandoned.
refusals.invalid_request: The request is incomplete or malformed. Check the branch names and commit IDs.
refusals.lookup_incomplete: The host’s current state could not be read completely, so nothing was dispatched.
refusals.not_found: The target or intent does not exist, or you cannot see it.
refusals.not_mergeable: The host reports that the pull request cannot be merged.
refusals.operation_conflict: This operation ID was already used for a different request.
refusals.protected_branch_refused: The branch is protected on the host, and publishing to it is refused.
refusals.push_prefix_overlaps_base: The push prefix would let a push land on a merge base.
refusals.ref_not_allowed: The branch is not under this target’s push prefix.
refusals.repository_config_refused: The managed repository’s configuration is not the one the engine manages. Nothing was pushed.
refusals.repository_outside_binding: The repository is outside the owners the credential binding allows.
refusals.runtime_credential_refused: A session’s runtime credential cannot publish. Act with your own credential.
refusals.scoped_grant_required: This action needs a scoped grant on this target.
refusals.separation_of_duty: You launched the session that authored this change. Ask another person to review and merge it.
refusals.session_source_refused: The session run is not in this target’s workspace, or its folder is not a repository the engine can fetch from.
refusals.session_source_unavailable: The session’s folder could not be read in time. Nothing was pushed.
refusals.stale_lease: The branch no longer holds the expected current commit.
refusals.step_up_required: This action needs the extra check for administrative actions this deployment requires. Complete it when asked.
refusals.subject_mismatch: This operation ID belongs to a request made by another subject.
refusals.target_changed: The target changed after the request was admitted. Nothing was dispatched.
refusals.target_in_use: A dispatching, uncertain or abandoned intent still holds this target.
refusals.unresolved_intent: An unresolved intent already holds this branch, pull request or merge.
refusals.unsupported_requirement: The host cannot honour this requirement, for example a rebase merge on GitLab.
refusals.version_conflict: The target changed since you opened it. Reopen it to see the current version.
refusals.workflow_change_refused: The commit changes CI workflow files, which this target refuses to publish.
refusals.unknown: The engine refused the request with a code this console does not describe.

intents.title: Intents
intents.empty: No publication intents are recorded for this target.

intent.title: Intent {{id}}
intent.description: What was requested, what the host was last observed to hold, and whether the host acknowledged the request are recorded separately.
intent.notObserved: The host has not been observed for this intent.
intent.acknowledgedHint: An acknowledgment is the host’s success response to this request. It is not an observation of the effect.
intent.observationsEmpty: No observations are recorded for this intent.
intent.abandonedNote: An administrator took responsibility for this intent. That proves nothing about the host. Its scope stays held until a new request names this intent under Acknowledge abandoned intent.
intent.abandonDescription: Abandoning records that you take responsibility for this unresolved intent. It does not change or read the host, and the scope stays held until a new request acknowledges this intent.
